name: Centaur Warden
description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
motivesTactics: use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

abilities.name: Flanking Maneuver
abilities.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden’s allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

abilities.name: Eye of the Sage
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19-20.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Quick Volley
abilities.description: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.
